answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn reputation, like a walnut shell protecting a kernel: the stake is slashed if peers catch cheating. A newcomer starts with only a zephyr of influence and must complete small, verified jobs to grow it, so creating many fake identities multiplies the locked capital and the waiting time. Basalt-hard economics make a Sybil farm pay for every identity while honest agents reuse one stake.
